items.title: 8scribo
items.summary:
8scribo is a haiku minting platform. Every poem is stored on-chain and additional stored as a traditional NFT. 
We are online since June 2022 and 863 haikus have been minted so far!

This campaign should cover the infrastructure costs for the next 12 months, any surplus goes into an on-chain treasury toward next year.
